name: capital-cities
description: Practise world capitals with hints, scoring, and a short review round.

interface.longDescription: A conversational geography quiz from teknologika.com. Answer one question at a time, ask for hints, track your score, and revisit missed capitals. Includes a small curated question bank. No external service or account connection is required.
interface.defaultPrompt: Start a five-question Capital Cities quiz.

publication.release_notes: Initial skills-only proof of concept with a curated question bank, hints, scoring, and review.
